## Description

Combines fractional cointegration spread models with multivariate Hawkes jump-diffusion point processes to capture slow mean-reverting spread memory and bursty jump arrival intensities.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency statistical arbitrage on persistent cointegrated asset pairs under volatility jump shocks.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Equity Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

High-frequency price series of paired assets, fractional differencing parameters ($d$), trade timestamps.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood estimation of Hawkes jump-diffusion kernels requires robust historical data cleaning.
